en.name: Actor
en.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly guess 3 players' character types (not yourself, 1 guess per type). That night, you learn how many you got correct.

revisions.v1: Once per game, during the day, publicly guess 3 players' character types (not yourself, 1 guess per type). That night, you learn how many you got correct.

en.flavor: "Have I played the part well? Then applaud me as I exit!" - Caesar Augustus 63 B.C. - 14 A.D.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Actor used their ability today: Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, or 3) of CORRECT markers. Place the NO ABILITY marker.

zh.name: 歌剧演员
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在白天时，你可以公开猜测除你以外的三名玩家的角色类型（每种类型限一次）。当晚你会得知猜测正确的数量。

revisions.v1: 每局游戏限一次，在白天时，你可以公开猜测除你以外的三名玩家的角色类型（每种类型限一次）。当晚你会得知猜测正确的数量。

zh.flavor: ‘我演好这部分戏了吗？那么既然我退场了，给我鼓掌吧！’-凯撒·奥古斯都 前63-14
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果歌剧演员在今天白天使用了能力，唤醒歌剧演员，用手势告知他猜测正确的次数。
